title: Namelist Extension
description: STAC Namelist Extension for STAC Items and Collections, exposing Fortran namelist parameters as CQL2 queryables.

oneOf.$comment: Collection: namelist:parameters, nested component -> file -> group -> key.

scalar.title: Scalar
scalar.description: A single namelist value: string, number, boolean, or null.

queryable_value.title: Queryable value
queryable_value.description: A namelist parameter exposed for CQL2 filtering: a scalar, or a list of scalars (possibly empty, heterogeneous, or containing nulls). Nested groups are dropped before emission.

item_fields.title: Namelist item fields
item_fields.description: STAC Item properties: every 'namelist__{component}__{file}__{group}__{key}' key maps to a queryable value; foreign (non-namelist__) core properties are unconstrained.

propertyNames.$comment: Foreign props pass; namelist__ keys are JSON-path-safe (word characters and the '__' separator only).

nested_parameters.title: Nested namelist parameters
nested_parameters.description: component -> file -> group -> key -> value. Every level's keys are JSON-path-safe (only [A-Za-z0-9_], a repeated group indexed as 'group_N') and registered as a dotted-path queryable 'namelist:parameters.<component>.<file>.<group>.<key>', for CQL2 collection-search filtering.
